Usage:
dotnet-inspect diff [<args>...] [options]

Arguments:
<args>  Version range and type filter. When no --package/--platform/--library is given, first arg is the package version range.

Options:
--package <package>                              Package with version range (e.g., System.Text.Json@9.0.0..10.0.2)
--platform <platform>                            Platform library with version range (e.g., System.Text.Json@8.0.23..10.0.2)

--framework <framework>                          Framework for platform diff (runtime, aspnetcore). Default: runtime
--tfm <tfm>                                      Target framework (e.g., net8.0)
--all                                            Include non-public, hidden, and obsolete members
--implementation                                 Select body-level C# and IL comparison (equivalent to -S "Implementation Diff")
--history                                        Inspect one Finding across a package version population; requires one full Type name
--at <at>                                        History checkpoint: exact version, #N, first, last, endpoints, midpoint, or all; repeat for sparse evaluation
--max-probes <max-probes>                        History probe cap (minimum 2); selects adaptive bisection unless --sample-percent selects a survey
--sample-percent <sample-percent>                History representative positional sample (1-100 percent), optionally capped by --max-probes
--major-versions                                 History: evaluate one representative per package major; API uses first stable, Analysis uses latest
--preview, --prerelease                          History: include prerelease versions inside the package range
--nugetconfig-directory <nugetconfig-directory>  Source: discover the ambient NuGet.Config hierarchy from this directory
